pieces.title: Wayside Evening
pieces.description: Three ridgelines settle into the dusk while the sun slips behind the nearest hill.

pieces.title: Colour Field I
pieces.description: Two soft-edged blocks of colour hover over a deep red ground.

pieces.title: Composition with Red
pieces.description: Black lines divide the square into a rhythm of white, with a single loud field of red.

pieces.title: Tidewater
pieces.description: Late-morning light over open water, the swell breaking into white along the troughs.

pieces.title: Nocturne
pieces.description: A bare tree keeps watch on the hill under a full moon and a sky full of stars.

pieces.title: Orbits
pieces.description: Overlapping rings of colour, each one pulling at its neighbours.

pieces.title: Meadow in Points
pieces.description: A summer field built entirely from small dabs of colour that only resolve from a distance.

pieces.title: Colour Field II
pieces.description: Teal over ochre on a midnight ground: a quieter companion to Colour Field I.

pieces.title: Birch Row
pieces.description: White trunks stand in a line against the gold of an autumn wood.

pieces.title: Current
pieces.description: Parallel lines bend just enough to make the surface seem to move.

pieces.title: Gesture
pieces.description: Fast, loaded brushstrokes laid down in a single sitting.

pieces.title: Harbour Lights
pieces.description: A waterfront at night, its lit windows doubled and broken up in the black water.

pieces.title: Three Pears
pieces.description: A still life in the old manner: fruit, a table edge, and a single window of light.

pieces.title: First Snow
pieces.description: The pines on the far hill disappear one by one as the snow thickens.

pieces.title: Composition in Blue
pieces.description: The grid again, this time cooled down into blues and a grey.

pieces.title: The Wayside
pieces.description: The road runs straight to the mesas. Someone put up a sign, but nobody remembers what it said.
